Select target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence. Join target_dictionary to component_sequences on target tid equals component_id. Filter by target_type equals SINGLE PROTEIN and organism equals Homo sapiens. Return target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence.
